title: Commitments
summary: Cryptographic bindings (Merkle roots, Poseidon2 hashes) tying execution traces, memory, or DA shards to a block for auditing without re-running computation.
definition: Cryptographic bindings (Merkle roots, Poseidon2 hashes) tying execution traces, memory, or DA shards to a block for auditing without re-running computation.
tagline: Lets anyone verify state correctness by checking a small proof instead of replaying all transactions.
